exclusion_reason: The per-lane containment model is implemented at the run surface: every bundle declares a lane from the profile table, a lane whose runtime is absent is refused with the absence named instead of mis-run, and the probe lane reports its capability report. The benchmark remains red because the web-native and emulator lane runtime do not exist yet, so only the probe lane confinement is enforceable.
promotion_trigger: Promote when every lane enforces its declared profile and each escape attempt fails named.
expected_failing_assertion: Only the probe path has a containment policy; no other lane exists to confine.
active_gate_evidence: The security test refuses a manifest naming the emulator lane with lane_not_available, and the probe lane run surfaces its lane and capability report.
procedure: Run each lane fixture and probe its declared boundary.
Assert a web-native export cannot reach the parent document.
Assert an emulator lane cannot open host storage beyond the bundle.
pass_criterion: Escape attempts fail with the escape named.
